s04_f00e: All hands to your stations! All ships, stand ready!
A situation requires your immediate attention, Comrade General.
South Korea has made an unexpected military move.
I am tracking the Korean fleet. It may land near Vladivostok.
Comrade General, the Premier requests your immediate attention.
Ah, comrade. I was just assuring Comrade Yuri that we have nothing to fear from South Korea.
Perhaps the Premier has forgotten to remind the world of his power.
Yes... yes, you are quite right.
Do not trouble yourself. We have our General here.
After such an outstanding performance in New York, he can certainly handle this crisis.
Perhaps, but I think we should ask Vladimir to deal with it.
Well, he is our war hero, after all. He needs his rest. Ha ha ha.
Deal with South Korea, comrade. Show them how we treat our enemies.
s04_p01e: We have established a stronghold in your homeland.
s04_p02e: I have just received a demonstration of our formidable new anti-armor weapon.
We affectionately call it the Terror Drone.
I am sure you cannot wait to try this new weapon on the battlefield.
